subject: [PATCH v5 9/9] mm/collapse: separate scanning a PTE table from collapsing it

2026-10-15.patch_summary: This patch separates the scanning of a PTE table from collapsing it into two distinct functions: collapse_scan_pmd() and collapse_pmd(). The scan function determines whether a range is worth collapsing, while the collapse function performs the actual collapse operation. This change improves performance by reducing the number of times the mmap_lock is dropped and acquired, and simplifies the code by breaking down complex operations into smaller, more manageable pieces.
